answer: Physical control challenge. Each identity must periodically solve a hardware-tied timing challenge over a shared thread of radio pulses, proving it holds a distinct physical transceiver at a known location; responses are checked against signal arrival times at multiple fixed receivers along the wharf. A single operator cannot fake many simultaneous transceivers without buying separate hardware per identity, and during a gale, timing jitter narrows the window so rented cloud capacity fails. The attacker’s cost is one physical radio plus site access per identity, paid continuously.
